description:
**BEFORE IMAGE — Kay Uwe Rott** *Mucheng Music World* **English 🇬🇧** Before the first melody, before the first image, before sound had a name — there was something waiting to be discovered. *Before Image* is an experimental ambient journey in search of the origin of sound. A passage through silence, resonance, and invisible spaces, where tones emerge, dissolve, and become something we cannot yet describe. Perhaps sound is not something we create, but something we discover. **On the search for the origin of sound.** **中文 🇨🇳** 在第一段旋律出现之前，在第一幅画面诞生之前，在声音拥有名字之前——有某种存在，正等待着被发现。 《Before Image》是一段实验性氛围音乐之旅，探索声音的起源。穿越寂静、共鸣与无形的空间，声音悄然浮现，又缓缓消散，最终化为一种我们尚无法描述的存在。 也许，声音并非由我们创造，而是等待着我们去发现。 **寻找声音的起源。** *Kay Uwe Rott · Mucheng Music World*

There were nights without a moon, there were days without an answer, and places we remembered only because they disappeared. But somewhere in the distance there was always something calling. Not because the road was easy. Not because we never lost our way. But because, after all these years, we never stopped looking for the light. And when we finally meet, we may discover that home was never a place. It was the moment we found each other.

But the light we carried when we first began is still burning somewhere. So if you are walking under a different sky, if you are searching for a place you cannot name, don't be afraid of the distance. Keep walking. Keep looking. Keep listening. Because somewhere beyond the horizon, another friend may be walking too. And one day, perhaps without knowing when, our roads will meet again. We will find our way home. Not because the road was easy. Not because we never lost our way. But because, after all these years, we never stopped looking for the light. And when we finally meet, we may discover that home was never a place. It was the moment we found each other.

这部四幕组曲的灵感来自威廉·莎士比亚充满魔幻色彩的戏剧《仲夏夜之梦》。音乐将带你走进神秘的森林，邂逅月光下的奇遇，感受奇妙的谜境，以及梦境中细腻而动人的美。
吉他、弦乐与双簧管彼此对话，在优雅的古典气质中融入想象、温柔与童话般的魔力。
对我而言，音乐不仅仅是讲述一个故事，更是创造一个世界，让每个人都能在其中找到属于自己的感受与想象。
✨ 欢迎来到慕城音乐世界——在这里，梦想也拥有自己的旋律。
🎼 聆听、幻想，让月夜缓缓展开。
—— Kay Uwe Rott *来自慕城音乐世界的爱与音乐。*

この歌詞は、台湾の著名な景勝地である「淡水（タンスイ）」の夕日、観音山、河口の海風という情緒あふれる風景を背景に、昭和演歌・歌謡曲特有の「物哀（もののあはれ）」と「切ない余韻」を見事に表現しています。 赤と暗闇の対比：紅に染まる夕映えから、徐々に陽が沈み黄昏（夕闇）へと移り変わる時間の流れが、主人公の「楽しかった思い出」から「孤独な現実」への心境の変化と重なっています。 触覚と視覚の描写：「解れ髪を濡らす海風」や「胸を打つ潮騒」といった表現が、主人公の孤独感や切なさをよりリアルに際立たせています。
